sections.title: Expressing Past Desires
sections.content: You know *bárcsak* from B1 Unit 5 and *bárcsak* + past conditional from B1 Unit 39. To voice an unfulfilled wish about the past ('If only... had happened!'), start the sentence with *bárcsak* and use the past tense and *volna*.

items.english: If only we had met earlier!

items.spanish: Bárcsak maradt volna még egy kis időnk a beszélgetésre!
items.english: If only we had had a little more time left for talking!

items.spanish: Bárcsak elfogadtam volna azt az állásajánlatot!
items.english: If only I had accepted that job offer!
